CommunityApplications.Profile:
**JellyGlance** is a modern Jellyfin dashboard for live sessions, user stats, recently added media, libraries, downloads, calendars, webhooks, and backups. It sits **beside** Jellyfin — not a Seerr, Sonarr, or Jellyfin admin replacement.
This repository includes Unraid templates for: - **jellyglance** — `ghcr.io/nerdy-technician/jellyglance` - **jellyglance-db** — PostgreSQL 16 companion (`postgres:16-alpine`)
**Install:** put both containers on the same custom Docker network (or point JellyGlance at your own Postgres). Set matching `POSTGRES_*` values and a strong `JWT_SECRET`. Open the WebUI and finish the first-run wizard with your Jellyfin URL + API key.
Homepage: https://jellyglance.com/ Project: https://github.com/Nerdy-Technician/JellyGlance Support: https://github.com/Nerdy-Technician/JellyGlance/issues
